semantic_delta: Coordinate transport generalizes presentation from R^d to an algebraically equivalent finite-dimensional normed real space while preserving the chosen original norm and source vector pairing. Conclusion explicitly records finite domain membership of the unique minimum, a consequence under SourceProper. No assumptions strengthened.
proof_route: Derive FiniteDimensional real E from e.symm.finiteDimensional. Derive Convex real D for D=effectiveDomain f from hstrong and finite endpoint arithmetic, with separate endpoint weights.
Unpack hsub as y,g. Transport SourceProper to f composed with e.symm. Invoke subgradient_point_finite to derive y in D; no separate hy hypothesis.

Invoke stronglyConvex_sourceSubgradient_growth with actual f,D,lam,y,g, source support and hdom=subset_rfl. The installed adapter genuinely calls stronglyConvex_support_growth and derives coordinate continuity internally.

Define internally L(v)=inner g(e v), derive continuity from finite dimension. For S={x | f x <= f y}, establish y in S and S subset D. Growth and opnorm imply (lam/2)*r^2 <= norm(L)*r for r=norm(x-y), hence r <= 2*norm(L)/lam, including r=0 and L=0.

Use SourceClosed real cut at (f y).toReal to close S; finite-dimensional properness gives compact containing closed ball. Derive S compact and (S intersect effectiveDomain f).Nonempty using y. Convert SourceClosed via sourceClosed_iff_lowerSemicontinuous; GENUINELY call separately frozen source_weierstrass_extended f S with global lsc, compactness and actual domain-intersection witness. This maps source Theorem A.3 explicitly.
Promote the attained sublevel minimum to global minimum: outside S, f y < f q, while f p <= f y. No infinity subtraction or toReal(top) step.
For any other global minimizer q, derive q finite from properness. Apply stronglyConvex_minimum_growth at actual p on D; equality of minimal values and lam>0 force norm(q-p)=0 and q=p.
